column2: Reconstruct the closed-system Figure 12 using individually addressable relationship trajectories, significant curve events, property markers, and event-derived Windows of Influence.
The temporal graph is no longer modelled as one material property = one curve. It now contains 9 addressable relationship curves. Material-property circles are a separate marker layer.
time_x and influence_y are normalised 0–100. Y means Extent of influence, not a physical material unit.
One row per plotted relationship trajectory (CRV-01 to CRV-09). Diagnostic colours come from the user's cleaned reference and are reconstruction aids only.
Defines origin, peak, decline, zero, re-emergence, plateau, bifurcation, capture, etc. Use these events to construct smooth curves. CRV-04 explicitly branches into A and B.
The two blue stimulus-impact curves remain separate from the 9 relationship trajectories.
Patterned circles identify which material properties participate at particular times. The same property can appear more than once and can relate to different curves at different times.
Defines what each Window of Influence means and which relationship/stimulus events establish it.
Defines the spatial instances for each conceptual window. WIN-06 deliberately has multiple instances because several relationships can be captured at different influence levels.
Do not generate the red boxes as seven equal timeline phases. Derive them from the event coordinates / curve segments they describe, with small visual padding.
Retained only for provenance. It should not drive the v2 graph.
Relationships and Relationship States remain the semantic research model. New curve mapping columns are working many-to-many mappings and are intentionally marked with confidence.
Direct, Secondary and Tertiary describe changing influence hierarchy, not permanent classifications of a property.
Later behaviour can embody earlier stimuli, state changes and accumulated material history. This remains central to Windows of Influence.

For the v2 temporal graph load Relationship Curves, Relationship Events, Stimulus Curves, Stimulus Curve Events, Property Marker Instances, Window Definitions and Window Instances, plus Entities/Relationships as semantic references.
The coordinate values are seed tracings from the cleaned reference images. Render them first, then refine coordinates against the original rather than manually moving red boxes independently.
This database still represents the closed reference system. Cascades, leaks, multiple ecological agents and open-system reparameterisation remain for the later iteration.
